design_philosophy: Swiss & High-Contrast. The dashboard uses crisp, 1px borders, high-density layouts, and functional color coding. Pure utility. Zero fluff. Color is used exclusively for state indicators and data hierarchy, not decoration. The overall vibe is 'authority and clarity'.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense and compact. The 'Control Room' grid. Every pixel is utilized for scanability. The layout relies on 1px borders rather than shadows to define structure.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white h-screen fixed left-0 top-0
spacing_and_layout.widget_container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-4 md:p-6

components.button_primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-sm text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400 focus:outline-none
components.button_secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-200 focus:outline-none
components.badge_hot: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-semibold
components.badge_pending: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-semibold
components.badge_won: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-semibold
components.input: border border-slate-300 rounded-sm text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all bg-white
components.kanban_column: bg-slate-100/50 rounded-sm p-3 min-h-[500px] border border-slate-200 border-dashed flex flex-col gap-3
components.kanban_card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-3 hover:border-slate-400 hover:shadow-sm transition-all cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing
components.table_header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest text-left p-3

motion.kanban_drag: Layout animations via Framer Motion for smooth drag-and-drop feedback.
motion.list_stagger: Staggered fade-in (y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1) for list items and table rows on initial load.
motion.rules: Strict adherence to prefers-reduced-motion. Animations should be snappier (e.g., 150ms-200ms) to feel highly responsive.

icons_and_assets.illustration_style: Minimal to none. Rely entirely on typography and data visualization (charts). Use clean Phosphor icons for actions.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against colored badges passes WCAG AA. Primary buttons must have high contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All key elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: `data-testid="nav-pipeline-link"`, `data-testid="lead-kanban-card-{id}"`, `data-testid="new-meeting-btn"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the 'F-pattern' reading direction. Place the primary KPI (e.g., Target vs Closed Revenue) in the top-left widget.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn Card component. Use raw divs with `bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm` to maintain the strict 'Grid Borders / Technical' look.
Ensure the context sidebar (Account details before meeting) is collapsible or uses progressive disclosure.
Kanban columns should look structural (light grey with dashed borders) while active task cards should be pure white.
Add 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' to your global CSS imports or Next.js layout.
All form interactions (assigning lead, creating campaign) should use heavily customized Shadcn components (Dialog, Select, Input) matching the crisp, square, border-driven aesthetic.
Do not use box-shadows except for the very lightest `shadow-sm` on card hover.
Create a robust set of UI elements with explicit `data-testid` properties to allow reliable testing.
Design files must use .js or .jsx if there are constraints, avoiding .tsx.
